names.note: Read out of doxologia.ro's line for 8 iulie, «Sfânta Teodosia», with the rank word left off.

death.note: doxologia.ro sets the whole story under «Dioclețian, păgânul împărat al Romei» and gives no year; she is beheaded with the twelve women before her son's own death, which the page dates only to 8 July. The interval is Diocletian's reign.
